heading: From a fuzzy prompt to a stack of shippable PRs.
description: Helix treats every request as a tree of atomic changes. Each atom is small enough to review and large enough to merge.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.description: Drop a prompt, a ticket, or a screenshot. Helix scopes the work and surfaces ambiguities before a single file is touched.

steps.title: Decompose into atoms
steps.description: Helix proposes a stack of atomic changes — each one a reviewable diff with a clear title, rationale, and dependency edge.

steps.title: Apply, review, merge
steps.description: Helix writes each atom in your conventions, runs your checks, opens the PR, and waits for your review gate before the next atom.

steps.title: Ship with confidence
steps.description: Every ship is auditable. Roll back a single atom, replay it on another branch, or hand the graph off to a teammate.
